title: Learn4Good Jobs Scraper
description: Collect public Learn4Good job listings from a Learn4Good jobs URL.

startUrl.title: Jobs URL
startUrl.description: Learn4Good jobs URL to collect, for example a category, search results, or listing page.

maxJobs.title: Max jobs
maxJobs.description: Maximum number of unique jobs to save.

maxPages.title: Max pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of result pages to inspect.

collectDetails.title: Collect detail pages
collectDetails.description: Try to enrich list records with company, full description, salary, posting date, and expiry fields. List data is retained when a detail page is unavailable.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy or custom proxy settings. Disabled by default; enable it only if you want to route requests through a proxy.
